testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect browser display preferences during sketch editing: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/workspace-layout/workspace-layout.feature:428:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect browser display preferences during sketch editing ✔ Given a part document is open in the MCAD Software with a sketch being edited ✔ And the model browser is visible ✔ And Auto expand Representations Folder on Open is enabled for the captured session ✔ When the user opens the browser header menu ✔ And the user expands Display Preferences ✔ Then the submenu offers Hide UCS, Hide Work Features, Hide Notes, Hide Documents and Hide Warnings ✔ And it offers Show Extended Names and Hide Blue Dot Indicator ✔ And it offers Auto expand Representations Folder on Open and Design View Expansion ✔ And Auto expand Representations Folder on Open is checked ✔ And the sketch viewport remains visible
